subject: Water Sewer Ratepayer Fees and CPC Nominations
overview: The council tabled the consolidation of water and sewer enterprise funds and postponed Community Preservation Committee appointments to allow for ratepayer fee reviews and nominee vetting. Other major actions included approving a tax title revolving fund and requesting code enforcement for ongoing neighborhood business violations.

items.title: National Grid Petition for Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Approved a petition from National Grid to install 15 feet of underground conduit for a new electrical service on Riverside Avenue.

items.title: Tax Title Collection Revolving Fund
items.summary: Approved the acceptance of General Laws to establish a revolving fund for the treasurer-collector to pay legal fees and costs incurred during tax title redemptions and foreclosures.

items.title: Consolidation of Water and Sewer Enterprise Funds
items.summary: Tabled the proposal to combine enterprise funds for two weeks pending a Committee of the Whole meeting to investigate a new 'baseline charge' recently voted by the Water and Sewer Commission.

items.title: Community Preservation Committee Appointments
items.summary: Tabled the confirmation of nine nominees to the Community Preservation Committee until they can personally appear before the council for vetting.

items.title: Information Technology Strategic Plan
items.summary: Requested a progress report on the 2016-2018 IT strategic plan, focusing on social networking outreach and online payment capabilities.

items.title: Traffic Safety and Speeding Mitigations
items.summary: Requested increased police patrols on Harvard Avenue and Arlington Street, alongside updates on the implementation of 25-mph speed limit signs and raised crosswalks.

items.title: Congratulatory Resolutions
items.summary: Congratulated the Medford Middle School String Ensemble for their silver medal achievement and the High School Drama Club for their production of Pippin.

items.title: Service Interruption Notifications
items.summary: Referred a request to the Engineering Department to review notification procedures after multiple unfulfilled scheduled power outages on Harvard Avenue.

items.title: Stone and Skillet Code Enforcement
items.summary: Requested code enforcement action against Stone and Skillet at 186 Winthrop Street for ongoing violations related to operating hours and heavy truck traffic.

items.title: Routine Maintenance and Moment of Silence
items.summary: Requested a cleanup of the City Hall parking lot and a sinking catch basin repair at 52 Dearborn Street, and held a moment of silence for late State Senator Charles E. Shannon.

items.title: 2018 Budget Template Petition
items.summary: Received a presentation from resident John Starello estimating a $169 million budget for 2018 and advocating for the elimination of government waste to protect taxpayers.
